name: Dolunay-Website-Project
description: Fan website for the Turkish series Dolunay (Full Moon): story, cast, all 26 episodes with a watch tracker, soundtrack player and best scenes. HTML, CSS & vanilla JS.

paragraphs: A fan website for Dolunay (Full Moon), the 2017 Turkish romantic comedy starring Can Yaman and Özge Gürel. Read the story, meet the cast, track all 26 episodes, listen to the soundtrack and watch the best scenes.
features: Responsive design with a mobile menu; no sideways scrolling on phones
Accessible: skip link, keyboard-friendly controls, visible focus rings, the native element for video (Escape and the backdrop close it), labelled buttons and alt text
Moonlit motion design, where every animation explains something and everything turns off with Reduce motion:

Hero: a canvas starfield that twinkles and drifts with the pointer (it pauses when off-screen), a poster that tilts in 3D towards the cursor with a moonlight glare, and the title revealing letter by letter on load
Navigation and filters: a gold pill that glides to the active page or filter
